Class RmiServer

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.network.server.rmi.RmiServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
RemoteServer, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiServer extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RemoteServer
RMI server implementation that allows clients to register with a nickname. It binds the server to a specific port and provides methods for client registration.
